maddeler.e:
أستجم (form X)
# أَسْتَجِمُّ (ʔastajimmu) /ʔas.ta.d͡ʒim.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
# أَسْتَجِمَّ (ʔastajimma) /ʔas.ta.d͡ʒim.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
# أَسْتَجِمِّ (ʔastajimmi) /ʔas.ta.d͡ʒim.mi/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَجَمَّ (istajamma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
